summary: Seven people caught in a series of large avalanches above Emerald Lake; no fatalities or injuries. Rangers advised backcountry users to avoid steep snow-covered terrain; CAIC referenced.
location: Above Emerald Lake, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: NPS ROMO morning-report compendium entry (2019-05-15), parent-opened 2026-09-19, citing CBS News; date pinned to "this past Saturday" = 2019-05-11 (Saturday-verified).
